items.title: Ruth Lion interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: I remember we were upstairs in a room that they had provided for Alfred and Frank and this gentleman, Mr. Paudras, to confer.

ctx.x: Well let’s take a look at some of the other things you have here. Because I wanted to look at this photo. Can you tell me what year this was?

That photo was in 1956. And we had gone to Birdland. He didn’t have — sometimes he’d have three sessions in a week. And we had gone there and we were listening. I don’t recall who we were listening to that night, but on the scene and enjoying it. And Teddy Reig, who he knew quite well, joined us at the bar, and someone came by and said, “Oh can we take your picture?” and they did. And that’s how that happened. But yeah that Birdland was a beautiful place in those days. They had the top talent. And Bud Powell, I…
No kidding? Tell me about that.
